note: Plate prints VINE STREET (today Short Vine), about 845-983 wide here; its west line is the plate border, with a plate tab showing Rochelle's stub continuing west (y 3160-3245). Rochelle runs 3162-3245. Heavy double line at x~897 and the pipe and sewer lines inside Vine are not street edges.
William Howard Taft Road is printed LOCUST here (about y 6030-6100; a grey band runs along its north side). Hemlock St. is narrow, about 7620-7690, with a 4" W.P. down its middle.

No name is printed for Shea Place. An unnamed 20 ft way (y 6500-6533) with a 6" W. pipe runs from Highland to Burnet and is marked with a large 86, which may be a lot number. It meets Burnet (about 4202-4290) from the west at a T. This is at the expected point.
Locust (today W.H. Taft Road; ST. printed at x~9070) meets diagonal Gilbert. Gilbert's east line is the plate border, and a plate tab (y 6000-6095) shows Locust's stub continuing east.

MLK Drive is MELISH here (about y 2355-2440). The vertical street (about 2960-3053) is labelled only AVENUE in this region and is taken to be Bellevue. The crossing is about 55 px south of the expected point.
Melish (AVE. printed on the east leg) crosses the vertical street at x~4196-4277, which is Burnet (labelled BURNET further south). Car-track curves are drawn in the crossing.

E. McMILLAN runs along the plate's bottom edge (about y 6898-6997; its south line is the plate border). Paris is only a stub tab below the edge (x 2718-2798) labelled '..IS', so the crossing is at the plate edge.
Chapel is only a plate tab east of Gilbert (y 3940-4016, labelled 'CH..'). Gilbert runs about 9642-9748 and its east line is the plate border.

Eden Avenue is printed BETHESDA (about y 37-128; its north line is the top plate border). The street taken as Albert Sabin Way is unnamed, 70 ft wide (x 2263-2376), with a 6" W. pipe and a 24" sewer; its west line is the plate border. A plate tab shows it continuing north of Bethesda.
VINE (today Short Vine) runs about 855-993; its west line is the plate border. E. DANIELS runs y 4522-4606. West Daniels is only an unnamed plate tab stub west of Vine (to x~795).
Goodman Street is UNION here, 40 ft wide, with a slight jog: the west leg runs y 1798-1857 and the east leg y 1815-1875, and the east leg is unnamed. Harvey runs about 5090-5177.
E. McMillan (STREET) runs along the plate's bottom edge (about y 6858-6957). Concord is only a stub tab below the edge (x 7855-7937).
Ridgeway runs along the top plate edge, about y 520-587; only AVE. is printed. Alameda is an unnamed stub tab north of it (x 5810-5886) with a 12" sewer.
